title: Conditions of Sale, Extract: Cancelling an Order Before the Goods Are Handed Over
content:
1. An order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment cancelled with at least the fulfilment service's notice
   hours before the slot is charged nothing, and everything taken is reversed to the method it was taken from.
2. Cancelled inside that notice period, the fulfilment service's cancellation fee is kept.
3. Cancelled once the goods are already on the van, the fee is kept and the goods go back to stock.
4. An order cancelled because the retailer cannot supply, because the item is discontinued with no substitute, or
   because the backorder days have run is charged nothing whatever the notice.
5. A deposit is reversed in full where nothing is charged, and a cancellation reversal is booked against the same order
   line the deposit was taken on.
6. A cancelled order never becomes a return. Where the goods have been handed over, the customer raises a return under
   the returns schedule instead.

## The first two terms on both sides of the notice figure (hypothetical hours)

The first term is met by equality: notice of exactly the fulfilment service's notice hours before the slot is at least
that many hours, and nothing is charged. Notice of one hour less than the figure falls inside the notice period, and
the service's cancellation fee is kept. On a service whose notice figure is nil there are no hours of notice to fall
short of.

## The three reasons of the fourth term

| Why the order was cancelled | What is charged |
| --- | --- |
| the retailer cannot supply | nothing, whatever the notice |
| the item is discontinued with no substitute | nothing, whatever the notice |
| the backorder days have run | nothing, whatever the notice |

## Points of judgement

**Where nothing is charged, how much of the deposit comes back?** All of it: the deposit is reversed in full, and the
reversal is booked against the same order line the deposit was taken on.

**The goods are already on the van and the customer cancels. What follows?** The fee is kept and the goods go back to
stock.

**The goods have already been handed over and the customer no longer wants them. Is that a cancellation?** No. A
cancelled order never becomes a return; a return is raised under the returns schedule instead.
